title: Mauna Kea
summary: Mauna Kea is the highest peak on the Island of Hawai‘i, a shield volcano reaching 4,207.3 m. The USGS says it is probably at least 1 million years old and last erupted between 6,000 and 4,000 years ago; Oregon State University says it began erupting on the sea floor about 800,000 years ago.

uncertainty.note: USGS: probably at least 1 million years old (a minimum). Oregon State: began erupting on the sea floor about 800,000 years ago. The span covers both statements; ages are counted back from the present.
